title: On testing the incentive compatibility of single-parameter allocation mechanisms
abstract: arXiv:2609.17406v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper is the first work at the intersection of game theory and property testing, giving algorithms and lower bounds for efficiently testing whether an allocation mechanism is incentive compatible (IC). We propose distinguishing whether a mechanism is $\epsilon$-far from being IC, i.e., when it observes many monotonicity "violations." Conceptually, inspired by the literature on Boolean function monotonicity testing, we construct a tester for discrete single-parameter allocation rules. Technically, our work is the first to consider monotonicity testing of vector-valued functions on the hypergrid. We give a $\tilde{O}(n/\epsilon)$-query algorithm to test whether a function (representing n-player allocation mechanisms) is coordinate-wise monotone versus $\epsilon$-far from it. translated_title: 关于检验单参数分配机制激励相容性的研究
translated_abstract: 本文是博弈论与性质测试交叉领域的首项工作，为高效检验分配机制是否具有激励相容性提供了算法和下界。我们提出区分一个机制是否与激励相容性相距ε-远，即当机制中存在许多单调性“违背”的情形。在概念上，受布尔函数单调性测试文献的启发，我们为离散单参数分配规则构建了一个测试器。在技术层面，我们的工作首次考虑了超网格上向量值函数的单调性测试问题。我们给出了一个查询复杂度为Õ(n/ε)的算法，用于检验一个函数（表示n个玩家的分配机制）是逐坐标单调的，还是与之相距ε-远。我们还证明了匹配的下界：对于布尔超立方体或超网格上的逐坐标单调向量值函数类，检验其性质需要Ω̃(…)量级的查询。
tldr: 本文开创性地将博弈论与性质测试相结合，提出了检验单参数分配机制激励相容性的Õ(n/ε)查询复杂度算法并给出匹配下界，同时首次研究了超网格上向量值函数的单调性测试问题。
en_tdlr: This is the first work bridging game theory and property testing, providing an Õ(n/ε)-query algorithm with a matching lower bound for testing incentive compatibility of single-parameter allocation mechanisms, and pioneering the monotonicity testing of vector-valued functions on hypergrids.
